name: Pure Agony doubles Quickdraw's critical damage bonus (#1767)
contract: Pure Agony 300789 is SpellFamily 21, passive (Attributes 0x1c0), with one SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) effect: MiscValue 15 (SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS), BasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = +100 percent, EffectSpellClassMask word 1 = 0x20, the bit carried by every Quickdraw rank (804193 through 806851, SpellFamilyFlags 0x40, 0x20, 0). Quickdraw is DmgClass 3 (ranged), so Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus (Unit.cpp:9926) starts from a 100 percent crit bonus (crit_bonus = damage + damage), removes the base damage, applies ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS) to the remaining bonus part (Unit.cpp:9956) and adds the base back: 1000 base gives 1000 + 1000 * 2 = 3000 instead of 2000, ratio 1.5. Darkslayer 680256 (SpellFamilyFlags word 1 = 0) is the untouched control. The tooltip's 'increases the critical damage by 100 percent' is read as the stock spell-mod semantics of doubling the crit bonus.

steps.label: Quickdraw critical damage before the talent
Darkslayer critical damage before the talent
Before the talent: crit damage bonus modifier is neutral
Pure Agony is applied as a passive
Quickdraw's critical damage bonus part doubles (op 15, 99+1 percent)
Quickdraw rank 7 critical damage bonus part doubles
A Quickdraw critical hit is 1.5 times the old one (bonus part 1000 to 2000, total 3000 instead of 2000)
